analyzed_vuln.description: Heap use-after-free in typed property assignment reentrancy: zend_std_write_property() stores `variable_ptr = OBJ_PROP(zobj, property_offset)` for an uninitialized typed property, then calls zend_verify_property_type(). During weak type verification, object-to-string conversion invokes userland `__toString`, which can mutate globals and drop the last reference to the target object, freeing `zobj` and its properties. After returning, code writes `Z_PROP_FLAG_P(variable_ptr)=0` (line ~796) and continues using `variable_ptr`, which now points into freed memory.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Trigger requires assigning to an uninitialized typed property with a value needing coercion (here object to string for `public string $prop`). The coercion path calls `__toString` (`zend_std_cast_object_tostring`), and attacker-controlled `__toString` must release/destroy the object being written to (PoC uses global `$a` reassignment). Control flow: VM ASSIGN_OBJ -> zend_std_write_property -> zend_verify_property_type -> scalar weak hint conversion -> __toString side effect frees object -> return to zend_std_write_property -> stale `variable_ptr` write/use causes UAF crash.
